Existing five-tab EN/AR/RTL contract remains the gate. Acceptance: stage select, empty messages, and Clear/Explore work in Arabic on narrow view without overflow.
5	Error recovery & accessibility	Not detailed in these store listings.	Accessibility terminal owns physical AT.	Five-case keyboard acceptance set (removed invoker, retained invoker, outside focus, unsaved/cancelled, Arabic RTL) remains the next UI gate.
Verdict

GulfTalent’s published labels correct any prior blanket free claim: Premium is required for profile-viewer identity and applicant comparison, and Easy Apply is labeled Premium-only on the two inspected job pages. Bayt and Naukrigulf advertise free search/apply with optional paid upgrades; Arabic is listed for both but not hands-on verified. No superiority claim is made. Highest-impact CF work remains finishing the owned acceptance gates (focus, bilingual browser/export, physical AT) rather than expanding discovery or application features that require data/provider work owned elsewhere.

Research finished. Available for the next evidence-based question. Heavy session remains Heavy.
